title: PDF action shows a loading state while exporting and a PDF export failed toast on failure
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the report with data.
steps: 1. Choose "Download (PDF)" and immediately look at the menu action.
2. Provoke a failure (offline mode) and choose "Download (PDF)" again.
expected: 1. While the export is in progress, the menu's PDF action shows a loading state and is non-interactive.
2. If the export fails, an error toast is shown: "PDF export failed." (dismissed by the user).
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
